# Bezier Spec

> Public specifications for the Bezier design system. Read the shared component rules and platform implementation guides relevant to your task.

This initial review draft covers Button, IconButton, Spinner, and shared action and feedback rules. Web documentation was checked against the source of @channel.io/bezier-react@4.0.0-next.15 at the /beta entry point. Compatibility with iOS and Android implementations has not been verified. Linked specification documents are currently written in Korean.

Read this index and its linked documents from the same tag or commit. Resolve relative links against this file's URL. Start with the relevant component, then its linked foundations, and finally the target platform's implementation guide. Distinguish design requirements from verified implementation behavior. Do not apply /beta APIs to the package's default entry point.

## Shared components

- [Component index](docs/specs/components/README.md): Published scope and review status
- [Button](docs/specs/components/Button.md): Text actions, hierarchy, labels, and states
- [IconButton](docs/specs/components/IconButton.md): Icon-only actions and accessible names
- [Spinner](docs/specs/components/Spinner.md): Loading indicators for indeterminate progress

## Foundations

- [Actions and feedback](docs/specs/foundations/action-and-feedback.md): Shared design rules for action hierarchy, destructive actions, and loading feedback

## Platform implementations

- [Platform scope](docs/specs/platforms/README.md): Shared design requirements and implementation verification boundaries
- [Web](docs/specs/platforms/web/README.md): Verified version, entry point, and API documents
- [Web Button](docs/specs/platforms/web/Button.md): Required label, variant, semantic, size, disabled state, and loading
- [Web IconButton](docs/specs/platforms/web/IconButton.md): Required content, defaults, sizes, and accessibility
- [Web Spinner](docs/specs/platforms/web/Spinner.md): String size values, defaults, and the status role
- [iOS](docs/specs/platforms/ios/README.md): Scope pending implementation verification
- [Android](docs/specs/platforms/android/README.md): Scope pending implementation verification
